events.title: Fizz & Ferment: The Art of Kombucha
events.description:
Fizz, flavor, and a little fermentation magic! Join UC Master Food Preservers for a 90-minute class all about crafting your own fermented beverages at home. You’ll learn the basics of fermentation and dive into the art of making kombucha—from brewing your first batch to safely fermenting and flavoring it with fruits, herbs, and spices.

This hands-on workshop will guide you through each step, with plenty of tips to help you create delicious, bubbly kombucha tailored to your taste. Each participant will take home a starter kit to make their first batch at home with confidence.

This free class will be held at the Oceanside Public Library Mission Branch. Registration is required.

Come ready to sip, learn, and get brewing!
events.location: 3861 Mission Ave, Oceanside, CA, 92058, US

events.title: Hands-On Fermentation Class: DIY Sauerkraut Workshop
events.description:
Get ready to bring old-world tradition into your kitchen with this hands-on fermentation class led by UC Master Food Preservers! In this 75-minute session, you’ll learn the fundamentals of fermentation—how beneficial bacteria transform simple ingredients into delicious, gut-friendly foods.

Participants will roll up their sleeves and make their own batch of classic sauerkraut, packing a full quart jar to take home. In just two weeks, it’ll be perfectly tangy and ready to enjoy—just in time for an Oktoberfest-inspired feast.

This free class will be held at the Oceanside Public Library Mission Branch. Come curious and leave confident, with the skills to keep fermenting at home!
events.location: 3861 Mission Ave, Oceanside, CA, 92058, US

events.title: Pickle Lab: Fast and Easy Quick Pickles
events.description:
Crunchy, tangy, and ready in a flash—discover the art of quick pickling in this fun, hands-on class led by UC Master Food Preservers! In just 75 minutes, you’ll learn how to transform fresh vegetables into bright, flavorful refrigerator pickles using simple ingredients and time-tested techniques.

We’ll cover the essentials of safe pickling, flavor balancing, and creative variations so you can customize your pickles with herbs, spices, and seasonal produce. Participants will make their own batches and head home with a couple jars of crisp, delicious refrigerator pickles to enjoy right away.

This free class will be held at the Oceanside Public Library Mission Branch. Come ready to slice, brine, and taste your way to pickle perfection!
events.location: 3861 Mission Ave, Oceanside, CA, 92058, US
